text: Carpentry defines a skilled profession focused on building or fixing structures and items from wood and related materials. Smoothing rough edges or surfaces through sanding stands as a basic method to improve both usability and appearance. Cutting wood into exact shapes relies heavily on sawing, utilizing hand tools, circular models, or powered devices. The craft also encompasses joinery, the act of fastening separate timber sections into one unified form. Together, these specific methods—sanding, cutting, and joining—enable builders to execute diverse tasks ranging from creating household furniture to constructing architectural components.
